facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter citing lack of substantial evidence of effectiveness · Filed (BLA resubmission) · ONS-5010 in wet AMD · not yet approved in US

evidence.summary: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a complete response letter (CRL) to its biologics license application (BLA) resubmission, indicating that the FDA cannot approve the application in its present form
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: because ONS-5010 did not meet the primary efficacy endpoint in NORSE EIGHT, it is recommended that confirmatory evidence of efficacy be submitted to support the application for ONS-5010
evidence.program_discontinued: Outlook Therapeutics plans to work with FDA to address the Agency’s issues
